question: Does the free sign-up of mediastack ask for a card? A static read of https://mediastack.com/signup/free lists Card Holder's Full Name, Card Number, Expiration Date and CVV (marked required) under Billing Details, while the rendered read of 2026-10-31 showed no card field.
why: The record says the free form shows no card field, and apilayer.com/faqs says no credit card is required for free plans; the static text may hold fields that the page hides when the Free plan is selected. Only a rendered look at the form with the Free plan selected settles it; the answer decides whether a payment method exists for an overage.
